title: The Wizards of Baking- The New Harry Potter Baking Show
article:
This is for all those Potterheads out there!

Oliver and James Phelps, the actors of the Weasley twins, have started a Harry Potter baking show called Wizards of Baking! “It's something which I've always wanted to do and I think Oliver as well. …” It airs weekly on the channel “Max” every Thursday at 8 pm. They gather up bakers from around the world who grew up loving and still love Harry Potter. The contestants are paired up depending on what they have in common with each other. The pairs of two make up desserts inspired by their house, their love for each scene, or simply just their connection to Harry Potter! For example, one team made the mirror of Aerosan, they called it “A Mother and Son’s Love”. The competition is very fierce so the judges are very particular about their opinions. Only a few teams get to go on the Hogwarts Express to travel to the next level!
